[i]Diplomat Isfan boarded the diplomatic plane headed from Irocco to the distant land of [nation=noflag]Sikirsk[/nation] as he steps onto the well-aged plane, he inquires an aide "What do we know about Sikirsk?" The aide clears his throat and replies. "Not too much, it's cold up there and they sell arms." Diplomat Isfan raises an eyebrow "Why are we engaging in diplomacy with a Christian state we don't even know that much about?!" The aide shrugs. Diplomat Isfan, though annoyed, takes his seat and tries to relax as the plane takes off.

Several hours later...

The radio crackled "This is Iroccan diplomatic airplane, requesting permission to land. Over."[/i]
Etherniasti stands with [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] and has also added [nation]Sikirsk[/nation] to their dangerous list and has imposed a travel ban on any citizen of [nation]Sikirsk[/nation].

[b]March 17th 2025 - Public Address[/b]
President Kaplan Zorlu sat in font of a camera, with his notes ready. He was about to inform the public that Hydronia was to begin military operations inside Sal-Baliz territry. The camera began broadcasting to the screens of millions of Hydronians.

"Around 3 hours ago, inside the great parliamentary assembly, a new order was passed. This order has given the military of our great country permission to begin operations inside Sal-Baliz controlled territory. I'm sure many of you will already know who the Sal-Baliz are, but for those who don't, they are an islamic extremist group based in the deserts of west shamat, who terrorise those living inside their territory. About 1 week ago, they launched an attack on our close ally, sherman. This prompted a huge response from leaders across the globe and as a result, intelligence gathering operations have been taking place since. Yesterday, when we launched the first two THEP satellites into orbit, we revealed some disturbing news. The situation out there is much worse than we thought. Entire cities lie in ruins across the desert thanks to the Sal-Baliz and the people there do not deserve the brutality they are given. We believe it is time for things to change, and it seems the only way to achieve change when dealing with the Sal-Baliz is military action. Tommorrow, bombing campaigns are set to begin across west shamat. We will rain fire down on the Sal-Baliz and make sure that they can never terrorise innocent civilians again! We also urge our allies from THEP and the ULR to take action too. It is in the best interests of all these nations to assist in the destruction of terrorism once and for all. Thank you for taking the time to listen to my address. Long live the prosperous nation of Hydronia!"
